config_resources: Release repository root; callers may override public weight paths

relative_dependencies.facenet_package: vendor/facenet_pytorch/ (include the entire original package and MTCNN data weights)

facenet.output: Original classify=False unit embedding; no extra normalization
facenet.preprocessing: PIL RGB; original MTCNN defaults (largest face,160px,margin0); original fixed image standardization
facenet.no_face: Only MTCNN crop=None invokes the frozen original official full-source box extract_face160 margin0 plus fixed standardization; no other error fallback
facenet.final_nms_sort: Original NumPy1.26.4 AVX512 argsort equal-score ordering emulated portably from its bundled Intel x86-simd-sort source; original NMS math and thresholds unchanged

wespeaker.output: Raw original ResNet34 TSTP output[-1], no L2 normalization
wespeaker.preprocessing: torchaudio.load(normalize=False);mono integer PCM cast to float without amplitude normalization;resample16k when needed;Kaldi fbank80 25ms10ms dither0;per-bin utterance CMN
wespeaker.model: Original release ResNet34(feat_dim=80,embed_dim=256,pooling_func=TSTP,two_emb_layer=False);strict avg_model backbone load,omit projection.weight
wespeaker.portability_only_change: Original release resnet pooling import uses an isolated module namespace; network bodies are unchanged

runtime: Frozen eval,requires_grad=False,torch.inference_mode,float32,TF32 disabled;one-file forwards preserve original behavior
diagnostics: encoder.last_records contains the latest batch;encoder.audit_records accumulates per-file preprocessing records,FaceNet original_no_face recovery markers,and errors for worker JSON output
failures: Raise with encoder,unique_index,canonical_path,io_path;never drop media or substitute zero embeddings
